newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs gently firmer ahead of tankan.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs gently firmer ahead of tankan.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures rose slightly in thin trade on Monday ahead of the Bank of Japan's "tankan" survey of business sentiment.
The tankan report is due out on Wednesday.

"We think the tankan survey is going to show the Japanese economy is weaker than people think. We predict the main index of confidence in the manufacturing sector may be down," said one Japanese trader based in Singapore.
Dealers said the gloomy outlook for the tankan had been broadly supportive of both JGB and Euroyen futures.
But much of this had already been discounted into the current market and prices could come off once the report was released, they said.
"We may well see profit-taking on Wednesday," said one.
September JGBs ended at 123.99 against a previous 123.86. Strong support was seen at 123.30/40.
December Euroyen stood at 99.09 by 1145 GMT, unchanged from its IMM close, on volume of 2,450 lots.
Eurodollar futures had a quiet session with September Eurodollars ending at 94.140 against an IMM close at 94.145 on volume of 2,330 lots.
